label: Contingent receipt entails unactualized POTENCY_1 in the bearer at esse
paraphrase: OPEN diagnostic R2 (NOT an accepted reading of De ente): whenever a contingent existent receives esse in some principle, the whole bearer is in POTENCY_1 in that same esse respect. In the adopted POTENCY_1 sense (CanBe and not InAct), this conflicts with existing-in-act at esse for any actually existing contingent. The general law in the reception controls verifies the resulting exclusion, so R2 is not usable as philosophical B4 support. Receptive principle-potency, which can coexist with the possessed act, is different.
